## What changed

**`xlsxops.Book.view`** now honours its `mode` argument instead of treating every mode as outline. Previously `view("text")` returned the outline rendering, so MCP and CLI clients asking for raw cell text got path-prefixed previews:
- `text` returns every row as TSV, no `/#[i] Name` headers, no truncation
- `json` returns the full workbook JSON
- anything outside `outline|text|json` raises `XlsxOpError`, so bad modes surface as errors instead of silently returning outline

**`mcp_server.py`** — `officeai_docx_view` and `officeai_xlsx_view` shared a `_view_reply` helper. Both now honour `mode=outline|text|json` consistently, and both declare `mode` in their input schema. `officeai_xlsx_view` previously had no `mode` parameter at all, so the LLM client could only ever get JSON. The docx `text` mode is no longer a hand-rolled reconstruction from `info["preview"]` (which dropped table cell values entirely) — it delegates to `Doc.view`, which includes table rows.
